requirement_text.ISS-0332: AC1: backfill updates pre-existing tenants' DEFINITION_PROMOTED to schema_version 2. AC2: R10 against pre-existing tenant succeeds end-to-end. AC3: idempotent on already-v2 tenants.

task.description:
Validate the test file at test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs (on branch feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826). Check out the feature branch before reading.

Gate criteria:
1. Every MUST acceptance criterion from ISS-0332 has a runnable test:
   - AC1: a test that shows backfill updates a pre-existing tenant from v1 to v2
   - AC2: a test that shows validate_payload FAILS on null review_id before backfill, PASSES after backfill
   - AC3: a test that shows backfill is a no-op on already-v2 tenants (no error, skipped count incremented)
2. No skipped or deferred coverage (no @tag :skip, no TODO placeholders)
3. Fixtures are isolated (use Letflow.DataCase per test)
4. Mutation testing was performed: at least 2 mutants were applied, which tests failed for each is recorded in the step-04 handoff result
5. The AC2 test explicitly asserts {:error, {:payload_validation_failed, _}} BEFORE backfill and :ok AFTER backfill -- not just the post-backfill state
acceptance_criteria: All five gate criteria checked against the actual test file
PASS only if all five criteria met
FAIL with specific missing coverage if any criterion fails

criteria.AC1: PASS — test 'backfill updates pre-existing tenant to schema_version 2' provisions tenant, downgrades to v1, calls Backfill.run(v2_attrs()), asserts {:ok, %{updated: 1, skipped: 0}} and schema_version 2 post-backfill.
criteria.AC2: PASS — test 'R10 event-append succeeds after backfill' asserts {:error, {:payload_validation_failed, _}} BEFORE backfill and :ok AFTER backfill. Both assertions present.
criteria.AC3: PASS — test 'idempotent: already-v2 tenant is skipped, not errored' asserts {:ok, %{updated: 0, skipped: 1}} on already-v2 tenant.
criteria.no_skip_or_defer: PASS — no @tag :skip, no TODO placeholders found in test file.
